title: European Press Prize — Innovation Award
detail: Laureate, with Guardian colleagues, for a year-long investigation tracing far-right radicalisation across a network of UK Facebook groups, built on analysis of 51,000 posts.

title: Huw Price Prize
detail: Best overall performance in the MPhil in Ethics of AI, Data, and Algorithms. Degree awarded with Distinction.

title: Harding Distinguished Postgraduate Scholarship
detail: Fully funded doctoral scholarship supporting the PhD at Cambridge Digital Humanities.

title: ESET Award for Information Security Journalism — Winner, Brazil
detail: For reporting on the cybersecurity debate around Brazil's electronic voting machines ahead of the 2018 election.

title: Prêmio Folha — Winner
detail: For an investigation into the personal-data trail internet users leave behind. Twice more shortlisted, for coverage of ChatGPT (2023) and of platform terms of service (2017).
